valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2024, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 6.19231e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 6.19231e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E a PEG divides is itself withheld, so there is no P/E to divide by the growth rate. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the period FY2024 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (iocolimited) is served under two keys, IOC.JO and IOC, that stand on DIFFERENT filings: IOC.JO is the fresher period on file, so IOC is superseded and withheld while IOC.JO publishes the current year. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
